title: Pack Builder meta-schema — candidate payload.schema.json
description: Validates Pack Builder candidate payload.schema.json (a JSON Schema document). Requires top-level JSON Schema skeleton plus properties.signals and properties.geo branches. Tallinn exemplar = minimal signal/geo property names only — not deep enum catalogs. Protocol: gateway wins on federation drift; MUST NOT rewrite Module-1 process.
$comment: REQ-46 §5.0 · GPT-PB-03 · AC-GPT-PB03-01/03/04 · gateway wins on drift · no Module-1 process edits

$schema.description: JSON Schema dialect URI for the candidate payload schema.

type.description: Root type of the intake payload object.

additionalProperties.description: Candidate MAY set additionalProperties; tallinn uses false.

required.description: Required payload branches; tallinn-minimal typically includes signals.

properties.description: MUST expose top-level structural branches signals and geo (geo MAY be optional at instance level but branch SHOULD be declared for GPT-facing packs).

signals.description: Signals object schema branch. Tallinn-minimal: declare property keys (civic_domain, failure_pattern, …) without copying full enum lists into this meta-schema.

geo.description: Geo object schema branch (district/settlement/region/… skeleton). Tallinn-minimal property names only.
